nodes.label: Automated Fidelity Grading Skipped
nodes.rationale: Playwright/Chromium not installed, compare.mjs screenshot-diff loop skipped by choice ([NO_CHROMIUM]); fidelity instead verified manually by screenshotting each Storybook story and comparing to ../index.html markup — informal, not the automated grading contract the skill normally requires.

nodes.label: package.json main/module/types/exports Requirement
nodes.rationale: The converter's exportedNames() reads package.json's main/module/types/exports fields (not the --entry CLI flag); without them the build silently produced 0 components ([TITLE_UNMAPPED] on all 8, 'exported PascalCase symbols: 0'). Removing these fields as 'unnecessary' would regress the sync.

nodes.label: docs: 0/8 components matched
nodes.rationale: Converter's docsMap discovery found no separate documentation source per component because each component's only doc is its .stories.tsx plus inline JSDoc on props; not an error, README/per-component docs lean entirely on the generated .prompt.md.

nodes.label: Doubled Group Naming (components/components/<Name>/)
nodes.rationale: Every story title is 'Components/<Name>' and the converter derives the group from that prefix, doubling it. Cosmetic; fixable by dropping the 'Components/' prefix from each .stories.tsx title field and rebuilding.

nodes.label: IronHealth UI (component library)
nodes.rationale: No provider/wrapper required — every component is self-contained (no context, no theme object to inject); requires only global styles.css import plus --accent/--accent-dark CSS custom properties set on an ancestor.

nodes.label: --accent / --accent-dark CSS Custom Properties
nodes.rationale: Never hardcode a hex for 'the brand color' — reference the CSS variable instead, so the color tracks the user's chosen system accent across Button, Chip, TabButton, NavIconButton, ColorSwatch.

nodes.label: isGymEnabled()
nodes.rationale: Ginásio vertical is a closed beta gated to ADMIN_EMAIL only, so loadAllData() skips exercise/plan/session queries for non-admin accounts to avoid wasted queries.

nodes.label: Nav History (pushNavState/applyNavSnapshot/popstate)
nodes.rationale: Android/PWA back button only exits the app when there is no history to traverse; each screen change (vertical/tab/admin) pushes a History API entry so popstate restores the previous in-app screen snapshot instead of closing the app.

nodes.label: onPhotoSelected()
nodes.rationale: Handles file input selection (camera or gallery, split into separate buttons per recent commit), compresses each image via compressImage() and pushes to photos[] up to MAX_PHOTOS.

nodes.label: Lightning Bolt App Icon (icon.svg)
nodes.rationale: Rounded-square peach/orange (#ffedd5) background with an outlined orange (#fb923c) lightning-bolt glyph — matches the app's orange accent theme (#fb923c) and doubles as the header logo button icon (data-lucide="zap") and PWA/apple-touch icon.
